headline: Maya walks: Lena held at 22%, Maya held at 18%
summary: Three sharks bid, but the gap between Lena's 22% and Maya's 18% ceiling did not close, and Maya refused Victor's perpetual royalty. The product passed the hero test; the business needs a granted patent and less ad dependence to command her valuation.
founderLine: I'd rather own the hero than sell it cheap.
